items.excerpt: Longitudinal study in NEJM AI tests whether AI-powered ambient clinical documentation actually improves clinician efficiency over time (Crossref created 2026-10-23).
Stanford SAIL year-in-review distills six themes in clinical AI for 2025-2026, from deployment to evaluation.
Correspondence warns that automation bias is eroding physicians' 'cognitive sovereignty' as AI-assisted diagnosis spreads.
A patient-facing conversational AI showed promising feasibility and safety in a single-center primary care setting, providing a basis for larger-scale evaluation.
EpiSemoLLM, a domain-adapted language model, localizes epileptogenic zones from seizure semiology and performs comparably to or better than epileptologists across internal and external cohorts.
Randomized, multi-model evaluation of LLM-driven AI standardized patients for clinical communication training, a cheaper scalable alternative to trained actors.
University of Pittsburgh researchers built a model that flags when a breast cancer AI result may need a radiologist's second look.
RSNA and other radiology societies filed comments on FDA's push to regulate generative AI devices: patient safety first, flexibility paired with enforceable safeguards.
FDA Digital Health Center of Excellence director Rick Abramson says generative AI devices behave more like a physician than a heart valve and may need to be assessed that way.
The AMA urges FDA to adopt risk-based oversight of generative AI and settle who is responsible for keeping tools safe once they enter clinical practice.
Doximity embeds Wolters Kluwer's UpToDate evidence content directly inside Doximity Ask, its AI clinical decision support tool for physicians.
STAT Health Tech: groups vie to shape the rules for state 'AI sandboxes' that would let medical AI be tested under relaxed regulation.
As FDA races to regulate AI medical devices, AMA CEO John Whyte warns against weak oversight of AI-delivered care.
의료 AI 기업 웨이센이 유럽소화기학회(UEG Week 2026)에서 차세대 AI 내시경 기술을 선보였다.
에이아이트릭스와 강북삼성병원이 의료진 문서 부담을 줄이기 위해 병원 행정 업무의 AI 완전 자동화를 추진한다.
베링거인겔하임과 마이크로소프트가 임상시험에 디지털 트윈 환자를 함께 적용하는 협력을 맺었다.
게이츠 재단이 연내 한국 사무소를 열고 바이오·AI 협력을 확대한다. AI를 시장 논리에만 맡기면 보건의료 격차가 커질 수 있다는 경고.
미국병원경영자협회(ACHE) 회장 등 병원 경영자들이 'AI가 병원을 바꿔도 결국 중요한 건 사람과 리더십'이라고 말했다.

FDA cleared Eko Health's Core 300 AI-enabled stethoscope, combining analog listening with noise cancellation, amplification and real-time heart data display. (Off-list sister of radiologybusiness.com; cardiology angle not covered on-list.)
FDA cleared Elucid's AI-enabled FFR-IQ (FFR-CT) software for noninvasive coronary assessment, developed with clinician feedback. (Off-list.)
Both radiologists and LLMs perform poorly at distinguishing AI-generated chest X-rays from real ones; researchers urge treating image authenticity as a data governance problem.
Harvey L. Neiman Health Policy Institute: evidence contradicts claims that AI has reduced the need for radiologists; imaging demand is projected to grow 17-27% by 2055.
Avenda Health adds an intraoperative Surgery Mode to its Unfold AI prostate cancer mapping platform.
